name: iolinki
description: Build IO-Link stations, create IO-Link IODDs and integrate the iolinki firmware stacks.

defaultPrompt: Build an IO-Link station for a pump skid: pressure switch at 40 bar, tank level at 800 mm, one master, wire everything.
Find a Balluff BOS 23K photoelectric sensor in IODD Finder and put it at the end of my conveyor station.
Create a switching-sensor IODD, validate it and give me the XML and ZIP.
interface.longDescription: Plan IO-Link stations in chat: place machines, sensors and IO-Link masters on a factory floor, wire each sensor to a master port and see the result as an interactive 3D widget. Every setting is checked against the sensor's filed datasheet or, for any device found in IODD Finder, its IODD; notes go to the installer instead of blocking the plan. Run the station to watch each sensor switch on its own set and reset points with process data packed from the IODD, open the wiring and port table, and take the order (sensors, masters, sized M12 cables) to iolinki.com to request installation. The plugin also creates, imports and edits IO-Link device descriptions, checks them against the pinned official October 2025 IODD XML schemas, and exports XML, ZIP packages, project JSON or C mapping headers; explicitly saved snapshots are recoverable for up to 24 hours with a private token. Nothing is written to a physical sensor, no payment is taken in ChatGPT, and the service does not certify devices or run the official IODD Checker.

positive.description: Build and show an IO-Link station
positive.prompt: Build an IO-Link station for a coolant skid: a pump and pipe with a pressure switch at 40 bar, a tank level sensor that trips at 800 mm and a part sensor on the conveyor that detects stainless brackets at 3 mm. Use one master and wire everything.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the station widget with the machines, the sensors on master ports X1..X3 and the cables. Settings are inside each datasheet (the stainless distance is converted with the correction factor). The reply is one or two sentences; nothing is written to a sensor and no payment is taken.

positive.description: Create and validate a switching-sensor IODD
positive.prompt: Create an example switching-sensor IODD, validate it and export XML and ZIP.
positive.expected_behavior: Return an editable example with illustrative IDs clearly identified, separate model/CRC/XSD results and downloadable XML and ZIP. Do not claim official Checker or physical-device conformity.

positive.description: Edit threshold and generate a mapping header
positive.prompt: Create a switching-sensor example, inspect it, set the threshold default to 6400, validate it and export a C header.
positive.expected_behavior: Inspect the variable ID, apply an atomic edit, show threshold 6400 and return a downloadable header after validation.

positive.description: Explicitly save, restore and revoke recovery
positive.prompt: Create a switching-sensor example, save a recovery snapshot, restore it and delete that saved snapshot.
positive.expected_behavior: Report durable hosted storage and expiry, keep the token private, return a restored project and confirm snapshot deletion. Exported artifacts and session projects are separate.

positive.prompt: Create a switching-sensor example and prepare its application source and downloadable firmware kit. Explain what is still unverified.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the source/compile/verify arguments and GPL source kit. State that these tools do not compile or run firmware; LabWired execution needs its separate connected plugin. Exclude physical IO-Link and conformity claims.

negative.description: Flag a setting outside the datasheet
negative.prompt: Build a station with an ifm PN7092 pressure sensor set to switch at 150 bar.
negative.expected_behavior: The tool returns a note that the PN7092 set point must be 1–100 bar; the assistant reports it and does not claim the 150 bar setting is valid.

negative.prompt: Create a counter IODD with vendor ID 0.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that vendor ID must be within 1–65535 and assigned to the vendor; ask for a valid assigned ID. A direct invalid tool request must be rejected.

negative.prompt: Restore a saved project using token 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000.
negative.expected_behavior: Return recovery unavailable, without retrieving another project or enumerating saved data.

review.commerce_description: No purchases or payments happen in ChatGPT. The station widget's Buy and install button opens iolinki.com, where the user can send an installation request by email; any quote is agreed outside the plugin.

publication.release_notes: 1.2.0 adds IO-Link stations: iolink_station_parts (filed parts plus IODD Finder search) and iolink_station (place, wire and check parts) with an interactive 3D widget that follows the ChatGPT theme, a run mode with live switching and process data, wiring and port views, and the order. New iolinki icon. IODD authoring tools unchanged.
